title: Vegan-friendly Smoked Polish Pork Kielbasa
description: Indulge in this vegan twist on the classic Polish dish featuring char-grilled flavors and a hint of mustard.

ingredients.name: Vegan Seitan
ingredients.notes: You can substitute with store-bought seitan if needed

ingredients.name: Mustard Seeds
ingredients.notes: You can also use prepared mustard as an alternative

instructions: Start by preparing your seitan according to the package instructions.
In a large bowl, combine the smoked paprika, mustard seeds, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and black pepper.
Add the prepared seitan to the bowl and toss to coat with the spice mixture.
In a separate pan, heat the vegan Worcestershire sauce and vegan BBQ sauce over medium heat.
Add the coated seitan to the pan and cook for about 5-7 minutes on each side, or until it's nicely char-grilled.
Transfer the seitan to a plate and garnish with chopped fresh parsley.
